title: Diaphanous Blocks
description:
Diaphanous Blocks change their opacity depending on the distance to the player. By combining one with any other block item in a crafting table you can change its appearance to that block, as long as that block does not have a tile entity. The other block is not used up. By default they don't have a collision box and vanish when you get close to them. The inverted version you get by putting them in a crafting table on their own has a collision box and appears when you get close. Putting an inverted one in a crafting table on its own turns it back.

When broken, a Diaphanous Block drops itself and keeps its appearance and inverted setting.

The change is gradual: a normal Diaphanous Block is fully transparent within about 3.6 blocks of you and fully opaque beyond about 6.2 blocks. The inverted version does the opposite.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Craft the base block, then combine it with another block to set its appearance

properties.label: Inverted
properties.value: Craft a single Diaphanous Block alone to toggle

properties.label: Fade distance
properties.value: Transparent within about 3.6 blocks, opaque beyond about 6.2 (reversed when inverted)
